artworks.title: Rene de Laudonniere
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a man from the waist up facing left. He has a mustache, pointed beard, wavy hair, and is wearing a high-collared shirt with a lace collar, a fur-trimmed outer garment, and a chain or cord across his chest. The background has a textured pattern, an oval frame with Latin text, decorative elements, and objects like a cannon and flag. Below the portrait, there is more Latin text in a separate section.

artworks.title: Teucrides Annaeus Lanicerus
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual with the upper body visible. The person is seated or standing in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. His facial features include a prominent mustache and discernible expression, with short, neatly styled hair. He is wearing formal attire with a high lace collar typical of the period, and a richly detailed jacket featuring decorative elements or embroidery. In his hand, he holds a sprig with a flower or small branch, and there is another object in front of him onto which his hand might rest. The portrait is set against a finely lined background within an oval frame, and the area around is filled with text, suggesting an engraved or printed illustration with additional texts above and below.

artworks.title: Philip Lansberg
artworks.description: The image shows a bust view portrait of a man facing slightly to his right, with his gaze directed upward. He has a full beard and mustache, a high forehead, and his hair is neatly styled and closely cropped. The man is dressed in formal period attire with a high-collared shirt and a dark, fur-lined outer garment. The background features an ornamental oval frame with inscriptions. Below the portrait, there is a text block in Latin.

artworks.title: Hugh Latimer, Bishop of Worcester, Protestant Martyr
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts an old man seated in profile, holding a closed book with decorative clasps in his right hand. He has distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose, a lightly smiling mouth, and a long, pointed beard. The man's attire includes a dark robe with a fur collar, and he wears a cap matching his outfit. The background features a textured pattern typical of engravings. In the lower portion, there is an inscription identifying him as "Hugo Latymerus" along with additional Latin text.

artworks.title: William Laud, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man. He has a pronounced mustache and a small goatee, deep-set eyes, and curly hair partially covered by a hat. The man is wearing a black cap and an elaborate robe with detailed edge work, possibly fur, and a folded ruff around his neck. The robe has large sleeves and suggests formality and importance. There is no visible jewelry. The background features an oval frame with inscriptions in Latin and English.

artworks.title: Andreas Laurent, Doctor of Henry IV of France
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man from just below the shoulders up. He is facing slightly to the right, has a long beard, straight hair, and a serious expression. He is dressed in a robe with a high collar. The background has horizontal lines, and there is a block of text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, facing slightly to the left. He is positioned from mid-thigh up, with one hand on his hip and the other holding a rod. He has a strong jawline, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, short hair combed to the side, and wears an intricately detailed suit of armor. The armor includes a decorative chest plate and shoulder guards. The oval frame surrounding him is elaborate, with various elements like fruits, ribbons, and scrollwork. At the top of the frame is a crowned masked figure, and on either side are symbols associated with power, such as a helmet and weaponry. At the bottom, a scroll displays the words "DROIT ET LOYAL." The background features curtain drapes that complement the ornate surroundings.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is facing forward with his right hand raised to his chest, fingers relaxed. The man has a goatee, a well-groomed mustache, and appears to have receding hair covered by a large brimmed hat with feathers. He wears a fur-collared cloak with an ornate chain over it, a high-collared shirt with lace edging at the cuffs. The background is a lined texture that contrasts with the figure in the foreground.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a horse. The man is upright on the horse, holding the reins with his right hand. He has a beard and moustache, and his hair is covered by a hat with a feather. He is dressed in detailed armor and a cape. The horse is decorated with a fancy saddlecloth. The background shows a landscape with fields, a river, and structures in the distance. The image is framed with text below identifying the subject as Robertus Dudleus Comes Leicestriæ.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and slightly turned to the right. He has a beard and wears a hat adorned with a feather. The man's clothing is ornate, featuring a doublet with a patterned design, pants with vertical stripes, and a cloak draped over one shoulder. His left hand is holding what appears to be a stick or cane, while his right arm is extended outward, resting atop a large elliptical emblem or shield that reads "ABRAHAM SPERES VAN ANTWERPEN" with intertwined letters "P," "S," and "A" in its center. The background is filled with patterned designs, and the name "GV LICESTER" is written near his head. The entire scene is enclosed within an oval border.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust engraving of a man in three-quarter profile facing left. He is seated upright and visible from the chest upwards. The man has a distinguished face with defined features, a prominent nose, and a well-groomed mustache and beard. His hair is covered by a hat with decorative elements, including a plume. He wears ornate clothing typical of the period, including a doublet with detailed patterns and a high collar. An emblem or medallion is visible around the neck of the clothing. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background features a decorative border with Latin text containing his name, "Robertus Dudleius," along with details of his titles and positions. The circular frame is decorated with floral and geometric patterns, with additional text at the bottom indicating dates of service.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man shown from the chest up, facing slightly to the viewer's right with a direct gaze. He has a full, curly beard and mustache, styled hair with a cap adorned with a large feather. The man wears a high ruff and a detailed jacket with buttons and a medallion hanging from a cord around his neck. The background features a textured design with a Latin inscription surrounding the oval frame that encircles the man's portrait.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image shows a historical engraving of a man displayed in an oval frame. He is seated in a formal pose, with his head turned slightly to the left and eyes looking ahead. The man has an elongated face, a beard, mustache, and neat hair. He wears an ornate outfit with a ruffled collar, a decorated doublet with puffed shoulders, a garment with chains, and a badge on his arm. He also wears a hat with a plume feather. The background has a densely hatched pattern surrounding the oval frame, with text detailing his title and name. The image is set against aged paper with rough edges.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the chest up. His beard and moustache are styled in a traditional manner. He wears a hat with a feather, an intricately designed garment, and a lace ruff collar. A sash with a beaded chain is draped across his chest. The background is patterned and framed by a circular border with text.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an authoritative stance holding a baton. He has a serious expression, short beard, mustache, and short-cropped hair. He wears intricate armor with a sash across his chest, indicating high rank or nobility. The frame around him features scrollwork, fruits, and a figurehead. The background has drapes. Emblems within the frame include a ribbon with the inscription "DROIT ET LOYAL." The style is etched or engraved.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.6 x 14.2 cm (7 5/16 x 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing confidently in a full-body portrait. He is holding a sword in his left hand while his right hand holds a staff touching the ground. He has a long beard, mustache, prominent eyebrows, and a composed expression, looking directly at the viewer. He wears a feathered hat, short hair, a cuirass with intricate details and pauldrons, plumed shorts, tights, and decorative shoes. He also wears a collar, a chain or necklace, and a grid-like background with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.artist: Karel van Sichem after Christoffel van Sichem I
artworks.description: The image shows a man in armor standing confidently with a hand on his hip. He has a beard, a mustache, and wears a cap with feathers. He is equipped with a sword and carries a staff. At his feet is a shield and a crown, and a helmet is placed nearby. In the background, there is a seascape with ships and a distant castle.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the chest upward. He is shown in a frontal position, slightly turned to his right, with his head further turned to the right. The man has a mustache, beard, deeply set eyes, and a determined expression. His hair is mostly covered by a cap with a feather and decorative band. He wears ornate armor with intricate patterns and floral designs. There are no visible accessories or objects held. The background features a simple oval frame with inscriptions indicating his nobility and importance.

artworks.title: Pope Leo XI
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of an elderly man, with a long white beard and dark eyes, wearing papal garments. He is within a circular frame with intricate patterns and symbols associated with the papacy. In the background, there is an open book and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Otto Leoni
artworks.description: The image is a sketch portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He has short, slightly curly hair, a receding hairline, a mustache, and a pointed chin. He is wearing a garment with an intricately patterned collar. The background is plain, with a circular pattern framing his head and upper body, and shading suggesting depth.

artworks.title: Walter Leslie (Count Leslie)
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man from the waist up. He is turned slightly to his right, with his face looking towards the viewer. The man has a long face, aquiline nose, and a mustache with a small goatee. His hair is shoulder-length with a slight curl at the ends, parted in the middle. He wears ceremonial armor with intricate patterns, and a lace-trimmed cravat. There is an oval frame with Latin inscriptions around him, and the border includes various objects like scrolls and instruments. The background has intricate hatching patterns.

artworks.title: Leonard Lessius, Jesuit
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table with a book open in front of him. He is holding a writing instrument and gesturing towards the book. The man has a beard and mustache, and wears a cap, dark robe with a cape, and a robe. The table is covered with a cloth and has books, papers, and a crucifix. The background is a study or library with shelves holding books and scrolls, a curtain draping above them, and a crest or emblem on the wall.

artworks.title: Leonard Lessius, Jesuit Priest, Professor at Louvain
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an elaborate, high-backed wooden chair. He is turned towards the viewer, with his right hand resting on an open book on the desk in front of him and his left hand holding a quill pen. The man has deep-set eyes, a mustache connected to a short beard, and wears a clerical collar, a dark robe, and a distinctive cap. He has a visible ring on his left hand and an ink well with a feather quill on the table. Several large volumes are on a shelf behind him.

artworks.title: Joannes Hugo van Linschoten
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the chest up, facing slightly to the left with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a broad forehead, pronounced eyebrows, a full pointed beard, and a mustache. His hair is neatly combed back, appearing short and wavy. He wears an elaborate ruffled collar typical of the 16th or 17th century, along with a buttoned outer garment with a decorative pattern. Around him are four illustrated oval cartouches displaying maps, landscapes, and ships with decorative borders. The background includes additional embellishments and nautical instruments.
